title: RAW UNREVIEWED: aiin/daiin as material and its original working agent in the whole seed rite
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. In the complete existing 37-group f31r.1–5 draft, derive the three daiin references from the actor who acquired the raisin material containing aiin, rather than give YOU an independent whole-word value. Preserve the actor after extraction, cloth placement and attachment to a recipient. A history-sensitive nominal rule is an explicit new cost; no universal d deletion or confirmed seed value is claimed.

design.mechanism: A typed nominal d+N construction returns ORIGIN_AGENT(E,N): the agent of the first explicitly written TAKE episode in the current instruction scope whose acquired whole contains the denoted material N. The episode and CONTAINS relation are arguments, not a hidden FormerOwner atomic type.
design.unit: All ZL f31r.1–5, 37 groups; all IT 35 groups and uncertainties retained. Three aiin and three daiin; all other old30 values and five clauses remain visible.
design.contrast: Stable original working agent versus current bodily carrier or latest named person, and versus an unrelated deictic YOU whole word.
design.prediction: All three daiin must resolve through the same acquired R/contained G to actor A. Binding G in cloth on W does not reset origin to W; neither a new material set nor an arbitrary nearest-person rule is allowed.
design.scope: Local typed C0 material family only. It is not a general d-prefix translation and not a legal ownership model.

additional_assumptions: The aiin GRAPE_SEEDS value, TAKE/CONTAINS/EXTRACT values, recipient role and the old clause boundaries remain unconfirmed parent guesses.
Segment daiin as d+aiin; bind the material G from the first definite seed construction. One observed base/derived family is not productive morphology by itself.

An imperative actor A belongs to the explicitly written TAKE predicate. Taking raisins R gives an acquisition relation to their explicitly CONTAINED seeds G; this containment-mediated extension is an added assumption and must be stated.
The origin-agent relation persists within one complete instruction scope and stops at its declared boundary. No default recovery is supplied for unrelated paragraphs.
Do not identify the person wearing cloth with legal owner or current working possessor. The rival here is bodily carrier/current recipient, not a historical source claim about title transfer.

The immediate carrier of G after placement is cloth C; the outer bodily recipient is W; original acquiring actor is A. These three relations must not be collapsed. The current-person rival explicitly composes containment and neck ownership, while a direct-container rival returns C and fails the person argument type; neither is an observed target edge.
two_discriminating_consequences: At the late f31r.5 daiin sheeody qokeor, origin lookup still yields A, although W was most recently bound by the neck construction. A current-carrier rule gives W and changes the release-agent argument under the unchanged RELEASE clause. This is a conditional grammatical consequence, not a new manuscript fact.

The three aiin mentions preserve G, while the three daiin mentions preserve its origin-agent A. Substitution of a fresh seed group would require a new written acquisition/containment relation before its d-form could denote A; matching the noun type alone would not license the reference. No new substituted manuscript case is claimed.
strongest_known_countercases: GDT1047 retains two IT paragraph-initial exact daiin with no in-paragraph left host. Therefore this is not a universal mandatory-left-antecedent rule; no accommodation repair is licensed.

In the same 30-value draft dar=NECK versus ar=PURE and dcheey=EXTRACT versus cheey=BEING do not inherit this meaning under a universal d operator. The nominal-material type gate is a real additional cost.

GDT1027 already stipulated the desired three actor identities; deriving only those stipulated outputs is not new meaning evidence. Its 26 singleton types, five fitted productions and 11 baseline bindings remain.

The complete IT alternative lacks a full derivation under all eight old ZL schemas; nine exact forms remain unbound. ZL qokee@149;, [s:r]air and da? remain unresolved and three lines anchor-ineligible.

IDEA505 preflight rejects a free hidden history field as a solution: the present offer must derive the history argument from the written TAKE/CONTAINS structure, not assert an ORIGIN_AGENT type containing the answer.

Root review of existing B06/B07 and A arguments: original TAKE actor identity was already fixed. This proposal presently supplies only one base/derived material family, aiin/daiin, and no second complete context with the same source-grounded constructor. Three old A outputs are not a new prediction or transfer evidence.
smallest_next_step: Review the proposed single history rule against B06/B07 and all six already fitted occurrences, solely to determine its actual costs and whether it merely re-encodes the old A table. No test of synthetic A-constancy. Before scientific selection a second written nominal core or a second already admitted complete context must make the SAME declared rule bind an additional participant without a new YOU alias; no such context is supplied here.
